title: Insane Woman Goes Ballistic On Police After Stealing & Trespassing
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 16th, 2023. Officers were called to a convenience store regarding a woman who kept trespassing & stealing. When the officers approached her she started saying crazy things and was immediately aggravated. Officers tried to calm her down but she refused to listen and walked away. This kept going on until one of the officers snuck up behind her and arrested her. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
